Is this still an issue? We routinely run almost identical tests on 4xT4 GPUs as part of CI, so I'm guessing this was something specific to your setup.

If it's still a problem, try with an up to date jax and jaxib?

@hawkinsp 
I encountered this issue as well. pmap hangs indefinitely.

For me, this happens if I use Cuda driver 545.23.8 and install jax[cuda12_pip]==0.4.20
